## Shark Throw

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/shark_throw.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Fishman Jujutsu. The one in front is seized and thrown over the shoulder into the ground; their own strength goes into the fall. Stronger in water. Needs empty hands.

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/tide_lock.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

## Current Counter

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/current_counter.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Fishman Jujutsu. The next blow from close by is caught and turned back like a current: the attacker is thrown off by their own force.
